de.name: Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
de.text: Dieses Museum in Sinuiju präsentiert umfassende Exponate und historische Artefakte mit Schwerpunkt auf der chinesischen Beteiligung am Koreakrieg.

de.name: Memorial Tower of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
de.text: Dieser imposante Gedenkturm in Sinuiju ehrt die Soldaten, die unter dem Banner des Widerstands gegen die US-Aggression am Koreakrieg teilgenommen haben.

de.name: Residence of Leadership
de.text: Die Leadership-Residenz in Sinuiju ist ein stark befestigtes Gelände mit einer großen Architektur, die mit den regionalen Behörden in Verbindung gebracht wird.

de.name: North-South Yalu River Bridge
de.text: Diese große moderne Brücke überspannt den Yalu-Fluss und verbindet die nordkoreanische Stadt Sinuiju mit Dandong in China.

de.name: Sinuiju Youth Outdoor Theatre
de.text: Das Sinuiju Youth Outdoor Theatre ist ein Freilufttheater für große öffentliche Versammlungen und staatlich geförderte Kulturshows.

hu.name: Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
hu.text: Ez a sinuidzsu-i múzeum átfogó kiállításokat és történelmi leleteket mutat be, amelyek a koreai háborúban való kínai részvételre összpontosítanak.

hu.name: Memorial Tower of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
hu.text: Ez az impozáns emléktorony Sinuidzsuban azokat a katonákat tiszteli, akik az amerikai agresszió elleni ellenállás zászlaja alatt vettek részt a koreai háborúban.

hu.name: Residence of Leadership
hu.text: A sinuidzsu-i vezetőségi rezidencia egy erősen megerősített épületegyüttes, amely a regionális hatóságokhoz kapcsolódó nagyszerű építészettel rendelkezik.

hu.name: North-South Yalu River Bridge
hu.text: A Jalu-folyót átívelő nagy, modern híd az észak-koreai Sinuidzsu várost köti össze a kínai Tantunggal.

hu.name: Sinuiju Youth Outdoor Theatre
hu.text: A Sinuidzsu Ifjúsági Szabadtéri Színház egy szabadtéri előadóhely, amelyet nagy nyilvános összejövetelek és államilag támogatott kulturális műsorok számára terveztek.

ro.name: Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
ro.text: Acest muzeu din Sinuiju prezintă expoziții detaliate și artefacte istorice care se concentrează pe implicarea Chinei în Războiul din Coreea.

ro.name: Memorial Tower of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
ro.text: Acest turn memorial impunător din Sinuiju îi onorează pe soldații care au participat la Războiul din Coreea sub stindardul rezistenței împotriva agresiunii SUA.

ro.name: Residence of Leadership
ro.text: Reședința Conducerii din Sinuiju este un complex puternic fortificat, cu o arhitectură grandioasă asociată cu autoritățile regionale.

ro.name: North-South Yalu River Bridge
ro.text: Traversând râul Yalu, acest mare pod modern conectează orașul nord-coreean Sinuiju cu Dandong din China.

ro.name: Sinuiju Youth Outdoor Theatre
ro.text: Teatrul în Aer Liber pentru Tineret din Sinuiju este un spațiu de spectacole proiectat pentru adunări publice mari și spectacole culturale sponsorizate de stat.

en.name: Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
en.text: This museum in Sinuiju presents comprehensive exhibits and historical artifacts focusing on the Chinese involvement in the Korean War.

en.name: Memorial Tower of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
en.text: This imposing memorial tower in Sinuiju honors the soldiers who participated in the Korean War under the banner of resisting US aggression.

en.name: Residence of Leadership
en.text: The Residence of Leadership in Sinuiju is a heavily fortified compound featuring grand architecture associated with regional authorities.

en.name: North-South Yalu River Bridge
en.text: Spanning the Yalu River, this large modern bridge connects the North Korean city of Sinuiju with Dandong in China.

en.name: Sinuiju Youth Outdoor Theatre
en.text: The Sinuiju Youth Outdoor Theatre is an open-air performance venue designed for large public gatherings and state-sponsored cultural shows.
